---
type: Big %// Table
title: Type with spaces and symbols
description: Its type normalizes to "bigtable" (spaces and symbols are deleted).
---

This concept's `type` normalizes to `bigtable`. It collides with the distinct type
`bigtable` declared in [bigtable_b](/concepts/bigtable_b.md); one of the two tables gets a
`_2` suffix.
